rows.note: This is the all-purpose Hong Kong Cantonese word for a place where medicines are sold or dispensed.

example.english: You need to take this prescription to the pharmacy to have it filled.
example.traditional: 呢張處方要拎去藥房配藥。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 cyu2 fong1 jiu3 ling1 heoi3 joek6 fong4 pui3 joek6

rows.note: Use this straightforward alternative when referring to a shop selling medicines.

example.english: The pharmacy downstairs from my home has lots of vitamins.
example.traditional: 我屋企樓下嗰間藥店有好多維他命。
example.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei2 lau4 haa6 go2 gaan1 joek6 dim3 jau5 hou2 do1 wai4 taa1 ming6
